_comment: Curated resolver overrides for titles the SOC taxonomy does not have. Checked before exact-title lookup. Candidates are O*NET-SOC codes; first = default.

entries.note: There is no official US category for software product management. By task list, Information Technology Project Managers is closest (customer needs and priorities, deliverables, plan changes, cross-team coordination); Project Management Specialists is the general version; Marketing Managers is where O*NET files the title “Product Manager” (pricing, campaigns, market research). Pick the one whose tasks look like your week.
